notes: Instagram Reels now opens inside the APK in a dedicated isolated WebView, replacing the browser Custom Tab. Instagram controls login and navigation. WebView has a weaker privacy boundary: the app technically could access its page; our implementation does not collect credentials or browsing activity. No diary bridge, cookie copying or page injection. Separate process/storage, HTTPS navigation allowlist with no diary bridge. Launch only while unlocked and outside Friend mode; only the Reels screen stays open across app switches and has no Dear Diary lock, screenshot blocking or recents blanking. Phone lock still works normally. Diary pages retain their existing gate/Friend mode protections. Bottom navigation now has Reels. Camera, mic, files and downloads are disabled. No physical-device Instagram login/Reels test. Install over the existing app, do not uninstall.
